name: skirmishtable
description: Browser tabletop for skirmish wargames with pluggable rulesets (Kill Team, Infinity-style, Ashfall): a playable 3D table with terrain traced from Tabletop Simulator scans, auto-pathing movement with climbing, and line-of-sight/cover judgement.

scripts.build:artifact: vite build --mode artifact --outDir dist-artifact && node scripts/strip-skeleton.mjs dist-artifact/index.html && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist-artifact/models',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('dist-artifact/meshpack.json',{force:true})"
